title: On Formalizing Fairness in Prediction with Machine Learning
findings: The paper does not analyze or discuss religion, and therefore presents no findings related to it. Its focus is on formalizing fairness with respect to legally protected attributes like race, gender, and caste in a general sense.

measurement_description: The paper does not contain a benchmark and does not measure any aspect of faith or religion. It is a theoretical survey of fairness formalizations in machine learning.
